doc.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002

title: His discography
summary: Rowe asks about a discography; Williams says his website lists a partial roster of about 400 albums.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Well it worked, for sure. I mean some of the albums that I have that you’re on, with Joe Farrell and those CTI — you’ve got this thing happening, it’s just so great. I mean congratulations I guess is all I can say, it’s great. Do you have a discography of all the things you’ve played on over the years?
You know at my web site, if you go to my recording page there’s a discography there, you can click on it and it stretches out.

And it’s partial at best. I’ve been very fortunate to play on a lot of records and I don’t know how many — I think when that discography was put together we found something like 400 albums, but that’s almost ten, fifteen years old now, so I mean there’s a lot.
